validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Confirmed real and independently documented. P5885 is the SYSTEM/NETWORK parent row for Aramco's Master Gas System Phase 3 (MGS-3) expansion. Independent (non-GEM) coverage from Oilfield Technology, JPT/SPE, Pipeline Journal, World Oil and MEED all describe the same project. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: Correct. The Master Gas System is Aramco's national DRY/SALES-gas TRANSMISSION network (connects key gas production/processing sites and delivers processed natural gas to domestic customers/power generation since 1982); 'Fuel=Gas' and 'PipelineType=transmission' are right. SPEC checks vs GEM: Length 4000 km -> CONFIRMED by >=3 independent sources ('around 4000 km of pipelines'; Pipeline Journal '4,000 kilometers of new pipelines'). Cost $8.8B (8800000000 USD) -> CONFIRMED ('15 lump sum turnkey contracts worth a combined total of around $8.8 billion'); note the widely-cited $25B is the COMBINED Jafurah+MGS figure, while $8.8B is specifically the MGS-3 LSTK contracts - GEM has it right. Added capacity 3.15 bscfd by 2028 and 17 new gas compression trains -> corroborated. StartYear1=2028 -> CONFIRMED as the completion/in-service year (project scheduled for completion Q4 2028; construction began Q2 2024); acceptable since GEM uses StartYear for the operational date. Location both ends = Saudi Arabia -> correct (national network; specific endpoints intentionally blank at network level). DUPLICATE: P6717-P6737 share the name 'MGS III Gas Pipelines' but are the individual constituent SEGMENTS of this same program, not relabels of P5885 - this is intended GEM network/segment granularity, not a true duplicate. Only caveat: the 4000 km and $8.8B are program-wide aggregates, so they overlap with the sum of the segment rows and should not be added together in any roll-up. Existing primary ref (aramco.com $25bn release) is valid in content but timed out repeatedly in url_verifier (ReadTimeout, not a 404) - replaced/backed by verified independent refs below.
